text: Assumption: Depending on instantiation, the concrete implementation requires its own synchronization mechanisms — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Depending on instantiation, the concrete implementation requires its own synchronization mechanisms — is this correct?
norm: depending on instantiation the concrete implementation requires its own synchronization mechanisms
assumption: Depending on instantiation, the concrete implementation requires its own synchronization mechanisms.
rationale: The specification defines conditional thread safety via the ConcurrencyType in the constructor, but does not specify the internal synchronization mechanisms.

original.text: Annahme: Die konkrete Implementierung dürfte je nach Instanziierung eigene Synchronisationsmechanismen erfordern — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Die konkrete Implementierung dürfte je nach Instanziierung eigene Synchronisationsmechanismen erfordern
original.rationale: Die Spezifikation definiert bedingte Thread-Sicherheit über den ConcurrencyType im Konstruktor, spezifiziert die internen Synchronisationsmittel jedoch nicht.
